import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    public static int modPow(int base, int exp) {
        long result = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < exp; i++) {
            result = (result * base) % MOD;
        }
        return (int) result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int p = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();

        if (k == 0) {
            System.out.println(modPow(p, p - 1));
        } else if (k == 1) {
            System.out.println(modPow(p, p));
        } else {
            int order = 1;
            int current = k;
            while (current != 1) {
                current = (int)((long)current * k % p);
                order++;
            }
            System.out.println(modPow(p, (p - 1) / order));
        }
        sc.close();
    }
}
